terrain.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
terrain.conversionPolicy: ETOPO EGM2008 orthometric height is consumed as the pack's declared MSL reference; sea cells use zero-metre sea surface and retain the source bathymetry in evidence.
terrain.uncertainty: ETOPO 2022 global land RMSE is documented separately; no cell-specific uncertainty is inferred.

atmosphere.uncertainty: POWER grid-cell analysis values; no station-scale or operational forecast accuracy is claimed.
